status: frozen Foundation 14 replication protocol; one pre-existing compatibility case is reused and all other cases are run after this protocol and runner are committed

comparison.baseline_solver: OpenFOAM Foundation 13 pinned high-gradient v2 matrix
comparison.interpretation: Compare identical manufactured inputs and measured outputs case by case. Version agreement or disagreement is descriptive; it does not by itself validate either solver or establish a defect.

interpretation_limits: Standard solver acceptance and sampled local numerical quality are separate verdicts.
A coarse-grid local failure alone is classified as underresolution, not a solver defect.
Cell-center derivative extrema are sampled diagnostics, not continuous extrema certificates.
No inference about singularity, blow-up, molecular alignment, physical hazard, or constitutive viscosity follows from this benchmark.
